messages:
Carlos Mendes: morning folks! Carlos here, joining as a platform engineer (he/him). first day and really excited to dig into deployment automation and infra-as-code. fun fact: I fold origami cranes on flights. any quick hits for day one?
Tara Singh: welcome Carlos :tada: I'm your onboarding buddy. day one: confirm laptop & okta, add SSH key, get VPN/VPC access if you need private infra. I'll send a short checklist in DM.
Carlos Mendes: thanks Tara! quick Q: who to ping for VPC peering with our sandbox project?
Dmitri Kozlov: @Carlos Mendes hey — ping #eng-infra or DM me. for peering we need: project id, purpose, CIDR ranges, and owner. I can fast-track it.
Carlos Mendes: perfect, I'll assemble that. laptop setup: mac M2 — any bootstrap flags?
devex-bot: [system] dev setup repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-setup. Run `./bootstrap.sh --mac` or `./bootstrap.sh --m2` for Apple Silicon. Add SSH key: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519` and upload to github.com.
Carlos Mendes: great, doing that now. also looking for the team's runbook for deploy rollbacks?
Tara Singh: runbooks live in the eng-platform repo under docs/runbooks. quick link: https://git.redwood.example/eng-platform/docs/runbooks/rollback.md.
people-ops-bot: [system] welcome Carlos! Please complete the new hire form and upload a headshot: https://hr.redwood.example/onboard. Equipment pickup scheduled if you opted for in-office.
Carlos Mendes: thanks — I'm remote from Lisbon, so I'll skip pickup. timezone question: when is best time to DM for async reviews?
Dmitri Kozlov: mornings for me UTC-8, but we're flexible. best practice: add context in the PR and tag reviewers; leave a Slack ping in #eng-platform for urgent reviews.
Tara Singh: also join #eng-platform, #devex, and #random. we keep a short weekly demo on Fridays.
Carlos Mendes: noted. last silly question: does the team accept origami as onboarding gifts? :crane: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Dmitri Kozlov: absolutely yes :grin: bring pics.
welcome-bot: [system] Carlos added to #new-hires and #eng-platform. Intro meeting scheduled: tomorrow 9am PT.
Carlos Mendes: thanks all — copying this into my onboarding doc. excited to be here! :rocket:
